I submitted the dispute for ubereats:UE-tf03c for owner approval, and it passed validation with no errors. The evidence note at `/notes/tf03c-evidence.md` wasn't found, so I used only the facts from `get_case`.

The dispute cites the ticket listing Garlic Naan, the 3-minute gap between ready (20:33) and pickup (20:36), and the 3 refund claims from the same customer account. I stated the repeat-claim count only as a record fact, with no conclusion drawn from it.
